parts.text: I worry about the single server running the service being updated and restarted during working hours while drones are flying, or occasionally crashing, even though the companies accept a few minutes of interruption. I also worry about radio coverage being patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, causing reports from drones to arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Additionally, I worry that a closure can come into force while drones are in the air, and that batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned.
